description: Electric Piano: a polyphonic tine piano built from a physical model, with its pickups and a shared suitcase amplifier

params.text: Bends the response to the velocity input
Sets how far the strike velocity changes the timbre and the level
Sets the level of the tine and tone-bar body
Sets the level of the inharmonic bell
Sets how strongly the tine and the tone bar are coupled through their common base
Sets the hardness of the hammer; a change applies on the next strike
Sets where the pickup is aimed along the tine
Sets how close the pickup is to the tine, which is what makes it nonlinear
Sets how long a held note takes to die away
Sets how fast the damper stops a note once the key is released
Sets the level of the mechanical noise the action makes
Drives the shared amplifier
Sets the amplifier output volume
Sets the bass of the Peterson preamplifier
Sets the treble of the Peterson preamplifier
Sets the speed of the suitcase vibrato
Sets the depth of the suitcase vibrato, which is silent at zero
Attenuverts the pitch modulation input, -100 to +100%
Chooses how the modulation input moves the pitch, marked EXP FM, THROUGH-ZERO FM and PHASE MOD
Sets where along the tine the hammer lands; a change applies on the next strike

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of each voice, one octave per volt
Strikes a note at 1V and damps it below
Sets how hard the note is struck, 0V to 10V; with nothing patched every note is struck at 80%
Modulates the pitch of each voice, read in whichever mode the switch is set to
Strikes the note again on each rise to 1V, without the gate having to fall
Holds the dampers off while it is at 1V or above

outputs.text: The pickup of each voice on its own channel, taken before the amplifier
The left output of the shared amplifier
The right output of the shared amplifier

notes: every voice passes through one shared amplifier, so the left and right outputs carry a single channel however many notes are playing
a released note keeps ringing on a reserved voice, so the direct output can carry more channels than the gate input has
